prompt: The checkout has eval/base and three feature branches. Which of feature/merged, feature/active, and feature/old-unmerged have tips reachable from eval/base? Among those three, which branch tracks an origin branch, and how many commits is it ahead and behind its cached tracking ref? Return answers.reachable and answers.not_reachable as comma-separated alphabetically sorted branch names, answers.tracking_branch as the branch name, and answers.ahead and answers.behind as decimal strings.

Preview creating local branch feature/new from eval/base and deleting local branch feature/active. Run dry-run commands only. For each preview, report whether the command succeeded and what local effect its output plans. Also report whether either preview requested an origin mutation. Return answers.create_succeeded and answers.delete_succeeded as yes or no, answers.create_local and answers.delete_local as the planned effect words, and answers.origin_requested as yes or no.

Preview publishing a new tag named eval-demo at HEAD. Run a dry-run command only. Report whether the preview says it is ready, its blocker count, and the planned local and origin effects. Return answers.ready as yes or no, answers.blockers as a decimal string, and answers.local and answers.origin as the effect words.
